extracted.name: Sautéed Summer Squash Side Dish
extracted.description: Learn how to sauté summer squash and zucchini with basic herbs and seasonings, resulting in a super flavorful side dish that goes with any meal.
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon minced garlic, or more to taste
1 medium zucchini, sliced 1/4-inch thick, or more to taste
1 medium summer squash, sliced 1/4-inch thick, or more to taste
0.25 teaspoon dried Italian seasoning, or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 teaspoon chopped fresh basil, or to taste
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a medium skillet over medium heat. Add scallions and garlic; sauté in hot oil until tender and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Add zucchini, summer squash, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper; sauté until squash is tender, 8 to 12 minutes.
